decision: Preserve protected-artifact SHA256 verification under the sha20.11 API and extend the canonical inventory only with four representation/streaming-reader contract tests.
reason: The upgrade removes io::Write on Sha256 and LowerHex on the output array. The bounded compatibility adaptation needs exact hash and I/O-error coverage while retaining every existing test, lane and zero-known-failure requirement. The independent TD113 artifact guard also uses the removed LowerHex API; adapt only its output-byte formatter using standard u8 formatting, preserving all assertions, expected hashes, modes and protected surfaces. Keep it independent of the production encoder.
verification: Guarded locked Cargo discovery must add exactly the four declared tests with no old-row change or removal. Bind the same zero-known-failure declaration to the new manifest. Fresh complete correctness/package/performance, clean release build and exact-head CI provide new-source evidence; the older declaration alone does not. The guard helper alone changes to equivalent lowercase two-digit byte formatting; no pin, test body, exception or guard acceptance condition may change.
not_tested: Inventory discovery, package-byte parity and source checks do not establish general wave quality, installed runtime or physical-client acceptance. No input, ownership, desktop or delivery contract is changed.
